Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Amy usually spends the weekend reading at the supermarket. People around Amy often share different ideas about the balcony. Her handwriting is neat and easy to read.
Amy bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The book is full of surprising facts.

The kitchen has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. Best of all, their little cabin sits high on the quiet mountainside.

Mia advised Amy to try swimming as a new hobby. Amy wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Tuesday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. The tabloids covered the trial with prurient delight.
Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The experience taught Amy more than any book could. The balcony looked quieter than usual that evening.
